name: Hotel Tyrol
beschreibung: Hotel Tyrol is centrally situated in Söll within the scenic Wilder Kaiser region. The property combines authentic alpine woodwork with contemporary amenities. A generous wellness area includes a Finnish sauna, steam bath, and an indoor swimming pool for year-round relaxation. Half-board guests enjoy multi-course dinners prepared with fresh, seasonal Tyrolean ingredients. Close proximity to the Söll gondola station provides seamless access to the vast SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental ski area. In summer, well-marked hiking and cycling paths lead straight into the mountains. Comfortably appointed alpine-style rooms with balconies cater perfectly to couples and families alike.
kurzbeschreibung: Centrally located hotel in Söll featuring an indoor pool, saunas, and direct access to SkiWelt.
